Question: What’s your opinion about a PIL that has been filed in Allahabad High Court against the grand opening ceremony of Ayodhya Shri Ram Temple?
Answer: Interestingly it is filed a Hindu by name Bholadas praying for the relief to Ban the Pran Pratishat ceremony of the grand temple on 22.01.2024. This useless fellow has pleaded before the Court that the temple cannot be inaugurated when the temple is not fully completed and the work is still in progress. He has also stated that the ritual of Pran Pratishat cannot be carried out on 22.01.2024 since it is Pushyamas or the month of Pushya and no Hindu temples can be inaugurated as it is inauspicious. This fellow also submitted to the court that some Hindu monks like Shankaracharyas of Kashi and Puri Mutts are boycotting the event on 22.01.2024 as the event is against Hindu shastras. Ayodhya Lord Ram Temple was prevented from construction for 500 years and in real life Lord Shri Ram suffered vanvas for 14 years and today our PM Narendra Modi has done such a great job to bring Shri Ram Lalla to life, however some disgruntled elements are behind this PIL. Did the Shankaracharyas put any pressure on political parties or did they fight for justice for the Temple? This is the reason none of the Shankaracharyas have been invited to the inauguration except the only Udupi Pejavar Mutt swamiji. From the beginning Udupi Pejavar Mutt was involved in the construction of the temple. After all these Shankaracharyas have nothing to offer towards social justice in our society as they are in deep slumber without any cause for the development of our nation, be it poverty, uplifting the Dalits or eradication of cruel caste system which was the bane of Hinduism. They did nothing for us. Recently I was surprised to see how the Sringeri Swamiji was blessing DKSHI who is a criminal politician. We must accept it is our honest Prime Minister Narendra Modi who was responsible for the temple construction, but still Hindus are trying to stop the greatest event by hook or crook. The Temple inauguration was discussed in detail with learned scholars from various sources and it was decided to go ahead with the program and this is not one person’s choice. The only grievance is the political consequences attached to this event which is going to take place on the 22nd of January 2023. Therefore, Bholadas is just a name sake individual but, behind him there are big names who want to somehow prevent the finale of the opening ceremony of the Lord Shri Ram Temple inauguration by our PM Narendra Modi and none can stop it.

Question: What are the chances of Dr. Manjunath BJP winning from Bangalore Rural constituency against DK Suresh Congress this time?
Answer: This is the most prestigious and toughest constituency for both BJP and Congress. As far as Congress and DK Brothers are concerned they must win and for Manjunath it is going to very extremely crucial for BJP because Dr Manjunath is a renowned Cardiologist in India and he has been specifically chosen by Narendra Modi and Amit Shah. It is also important for JDS since Dr Manjunath is the son-in-law of former PM Devegowda. If the Cardiologist wins against DK Brothers then it will give a great morale boost for Devegowda as it is reeling under pressure because of Pen Drive Scandal from Revanna family. In so far as DK Brothers are concerned it is believed that they may take the first lead from Kanakapura segment since it is their strongest fortress. Against this crucial lead, our Cardiologist must neutralise the damage by taking his lead from Channapatna as this segment comes under HDK and Yogeshwar who are strong Vokkaliga leaders. Presuming that both are fighting neck to neck, Doctor must take his first lead from Anekal, Bangalore South (a few areas coming under Tajeswi Surya constituency) and RR Nagar segments since these areas have substantial educated population. Next segments are Magadi and Ramnagara which has substantial Vokkaliga population and here HDK and Devegowda have a strong base however, DK Brothers have been working day and night to build their base. RR Nagar and Bangalore South has substantial urban voters which we shouldn’t forget. Kunigal segment may go either way but, here also DK Brothers have been working hard to get rid of BJP. Last election DK Suresh had won with a lead of 2,06000 votes against Ashwathnarayana from BJP. Last time the total polling numbers were 8,78,528 votes per DK Suresh and BJP got 6,71,388 votes. This time that margin of 2,06000 votes may be recovered by BJP because this time there are 2,91,000 new voters who are youngsters. We must also remember that there are several Apartments who have voted and Doctor had visited these Apartments personally and canvassed to vote for him. There are roughly about 29,00,000 voters in this particular constituency. Narendra Modi and Amit Shah are expecting Doctor to win against DKBrothers this time. If DK Suresh loses then DKSHI will suffer the biggest loss as Suresh is the right hand man to him. If Manjunath wins then the entire political landscape will definitely change in Karnataka as Manjunath will not only be inducted into central cabinet but, he will be projected as the next CM of Karnataka and this will boost the morale of the Vokkaliga community.
